# Your CRM Name

> Web-based CRM for managing leads, WhatsApp conversations, campaigns, documents and storage in one place.

## Main pages

- [WhatsApp Inbox](https://your-domain.com/whatsapp-inbox): Team inbox for live WhatsApp chats, replies, attachments and linking chats to CRM leads.
- [WhatsApp Bulk Campaign Studio](https://your-domain.com/whatsapp-campaign): Create and send bulk WhatsApp campaigns.
- [Integrations](https://your-domain.com/integrations): Connect a WhatsApp device by scanning a QR code.
- [Vault](https://your-domain.com/vault): Secure storage for sensitive files.
- [Storage](https://your-domain.com/storage): File storage and management.
